recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No core follow-up is needed unless a future PA decision changes the meaning of allDay or reverses the shared Availability wording.
issue_request: FHIR-32498 was Published/Persuasive for R5. Despite a confusing title/description, the accepted PA resolution says allDay short and long descriptions should use i.e. rather than e.g. because allDay always means 24-hour availability, and the same wording should be applied to HealthcareService and Location.
initial_application: The issue was applied in Jira-tagged commits c1be0e746c for PractitionerRole.availableTime.allDay, b2d93d1bec for HealthcareService.availableTime.allDay, and d6f3dcdcee for Location.hoursOfOperation.allDay. Commit 447e89f4a4 later refactored those availability fields into the shared Availability datatype while preserving the i.e. wording.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini actively includes Availability and the affected resources, and records R5 mappings from old resource-specific allDay paths to the shared Availability paths. Current HealthcareService, Location, and PractitionerRole StructureDefinitions use type Availability. PA January 2022 WGM minutes confirm the 7-0-0 vote, the title/description confusion, and the HealthcareService/Location scope. Zulip searches found no conflicting discussion.
reconciliation: Published an empty audit commit only. No source edit is needed because source/datatypes/availability.xml already contains the authoritative allDay short and long definitions with i.e. 24 hour service, and no current source definition under source/ still uses the rejected e.g. wording for allDay.
